Gakusei seito seikatsu chōsa (Survey of Students' Lives), 昭和13年11月調査 · 上: 專門學校 (vocational colleges) · 下: universities, higher schools, preparatory courses, higher normal schools and women's colleges
文部省教學局 (Bureau of Education and Learning, Ministry of Education), 東京, 1939; two volumes (上・下)

Every table is transcribed, including the errata slip (訂正) in 下. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (front matter by Claude Haiku 5.5) from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye. 上 is a dark microfilm; in 下 the italic ratio (比率) figures are blurred and the column next to the binding is often washed out, so many ratio cells there are [?] (the counts are nearly all read). Printed totals that do not add up, and the frequent misprints in the ratio columns, are kept as printed and noted.
